audit_items.proof_trace: The errorHandler uses `NODE_ENV !== 'production'` to gate `details`, which is technically broader than the property's `== 'development'` requirement (staging/test/undefined would also expose err.message). However, all three production deployment paths (docker-compose.yml:12 hardcodes `NODE_ENV=production`, ecosystem.config.json:11 sets same for pm2, .env.example:14 documents it as default) guarantee `details` is always `undefined` in production. No route handler catch block exposes `e.message` directly — all return generic strings independently of the global handler.
